on-dark.$description: Text sitting on a dark fill

border-danger.$description: Invalid. Border changes, fill does not.

value-read-only.$description: FULL contrast — this is what separates read-only from disabled

border.$description: 3.06:1 — required

mark-disabled.$description: Stays maximally light so the tick still reads

border.$description: 3.06:1 — required

track-on-disabled.$description: deltaE 12.9 from track-off — distinguishable, and the thumb position confirms it

border.$description: REQUIRED. Every track sits below 3:1, so the border carries 1.4.11.

thumb-disabled.$description: Stays light so position still reads when disabled

track-filled.$description: Single value: origin to thumb. Range: between the two thumbs.

thumb-border.$description: 3:1 required — the thumb is the control

indicator.$description: 3:1 required — this is what marks the current tab

track.$description: The rule the indicator sits on

surface.$description: The container the pills sit in
